info.title: Leadership OS API
info.description:
Complete API specification for the Leadership Operating System.

**410 endpoints** across 143 domains.

All endpoints support:
- Hash-chained audit trails
- Role-based access control (viewer/editor/admin/auditor)
- Rate limiting (token bucket + sliding window)
- Request/response logging with correlation IDs

post.description: Only an authenticated admin may assign a privileged role at signup;
AI safety: prompt isolation, DLP, abstention
